source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names from the OCR text of the page, which is clean (not compared line by line with the image); returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1952: no seat contested. The 1952 list prints no party labels. Returned unopposed. Thomas G. Conn: no party label printed in 1952. At other elections he stood as Unionist (Armaghbrague, 3 October 1946, printed 'U': Frontier Sentinel, 28 September 1946, p. 5 ("Armagh Rural Council"); Armaghbrague, 5 June 1958, printed 'U': Armagh Guardian, 23 May 1958, p. 4 ("Only Rural Contest in Clady")).
